artifacts.summary: Recommends a new one-page standards file (post-incident-verification-checklist.md) over appending to git-safety.md/git-staging-scope.md/git-workflow-narrative.md/recovery.md, gives verified concrete stash+reflog commands for check (1), and pinpoints the exact guard-hook refusal-text insertion line (614/615, inside the stash_revert conditional only).

memory_candidates.content: After a bare/whole-tree git stash reverts a dirty tree, git status and git diff HEAD come back completely empty even though pre-session uncommitted work now sits only inside the stash entry -- a reverted file matches HEAD and reads as clean to every naive check. Verification scoped to 'sibling commits + own edits' will miss this category entirely. Concrete recovery commands: git stash list; git diff --stat HEAD stash@{N}; git stash show -p -u stash@{N} (the -u is required to see untracked content, a bare 'git stash show -p' omits it); and if the entry was already popped-and-failed or dropped, git fsck --unreachable --no-reflog | grep commit recovers the still-unreachable stash commit objects for inspection via git show --stat <sha>.
